phases.note: Cold dusk on the island, storm building.
Rain starting, Saint Calder's glow ahead.
Roaring storm; lightning is how the rocks are seen.
The beacon sweeps the water; the sea is readable again.

moon.flighted_icon_hint: A perfect black sphere with a faint silver rim over a dim cloud gap; never lit enough to light the scene.

lightning.note: Cold silver-white flash with a short afterglow; flashes place hazards in black silhouette against the sea.

sources.behaviour: Rotating beam; dark, then failing flicker, then steady sweep once relit.
Harsh crackling arc with a dynamo hum flicker.
Slow pulsing furnace glow that rises when coal is fed.
Dim warm window light with a slight gas flicker.
Steady brass lantern that sways with the hull; does not reveal hazards beyond its range.
Static emissive window cards with a faint electric shimmer.

saint_calder.technique: Emissive window cards and a cathedral silhouette billboard, depth-faded by fog, no real lights.
saint_calder.flicker: Very slow random shimmer of a few windows; the cathedral stays steady.
saint_calder.note: Scenery only: warm glow against the dark coast. It must not line up as a goal marker for the crossing.

legibility_checks: Hazards: at RETURN the nearest rock reads as a silhouette at its hazard_visibility_m with no flash.
Lightning: a flash never washes out a hazard to white; hazards read darker than the sea during a flash.
Beacon: dark at the start, then relit; the sweep is visible from DOCK_PORT without being a marker.
Saint Calder: visible through fog from the outbound start, amber and gold only, never brighter than the beacon.
Photosensitivity: record 60 s of RETURN and confirm no more than 3 flashes in any second.
open_creator_decisions: How bright the eclipsed moon's silver rim may be.
Whether Saint Calder should flicker or stay fully steady.
